name: Nearest Neighbor SDF Tree Traversal
definition: An algorithm to compute the signed distance to a scene represented by a hierarchical SDF tree (downtree and uptree buffers) for a given query point, using a stack-based traversal that supports union pruning and continuous axis-aligned (CAA) cloning.
summary: Nearest Neighbor SDF Tree Traversal computes signed distances in hierarchical SDF scenes using union pruning and dual-buffer traversal, differing from standard octree methods by evaluating analytical distances for ray marching.
